context: Ren brings over a new fighting game; Riku has played the demo. They settle in for a casual evening.
purpose: older / younger cousin male bonding through games — easy familiarity

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: リク、これやろうぜ。新しいやつ。
lines.en: Riku, let's play this. The new one.
lines.style: University student easy older-bro lift, casual familiar drawl, real enthusiasm threading through unforced delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お、それ気になってた！面白いの？
lines.en: Oh, I've been curious about that! Is it good?
lines.style: Teen bright bouncing interest, voice lifting on the question, real eager curiosity carrying through enthusiastically.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: めっちゃ面白い。でも俺、まだ下手。
lines.en: Super fun. But I'm still bad at it.
lines.style: University student honest casual admission, dropping the bravado, real self-aware warmth threading through throughout.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ俺も練習するから、勝負しよう！
lines.en: Then I'll practice too, let's have a match!
lines.style: Teen energetic challenge lift, the eager competitive spirit bright and warm, real youthful drive throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 負けたら、ジュース奢ること。
lines.style: University student casual stakes setting, the playful gambling-light tone, real older-bro warmth audible underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 受けて立つ！今日は負けない！
lines.en: Challenge accepted! Today I won't lose!
lines.style: Teen dramatic confident burst, the energetic competitive declaration carrying full youthful bravado warmly throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おっ、いい感じ。じゃあ始めるか。
lines.en: Oh, good energy. Let's start then.
lines.style: University student approving warm continuation, the casual older-bro affirmation, easy momentum carrying forward throughout.
